text: vittasuttaṃ [202] kiṃsūdha vittaṃ purisassa seṭṭhaṃ kiṃsu suciṇṇo 3 sukhamāvahāti #1 ma. yu. chetvāvaggo . 2 sī. jhatvā . yu. chetvā . 3 suciṇṇantipi #pāṭhena bhavitabbaṃ . kiṃsu have sādhutaraṃ rasānaṃ kathaṃjīvī 1 jīvitamāhu seṭṭhanti . [203] saddhīdha vittaṃ purisassa seṭṭhaṃ dhammo suciṇṇo sukhamāvahāti saccaṃ have sādhutaraṃ rasānaṃ paññājīvī jīvitamāhu seṭṭhanti . catutthaṃ
